answer: With a Weekly community check-in streak over ninety days verified by signed timestamps, trust accrues only through repeated presence: every week the applicant signs in, the signed timestamps go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so a fake identity that lapses even once loses its standing and must start over.
